policy: These numeric sub-sections expand the existing Project Level 0 and Level 1 without replacing parent canon. Parent state.level.number remains 0 or 1; entering a sub-level changes the human-readable location only. Project WORLD, ENTITY and ITEM hard locks remain authoritative. External factions, neutral/friendly Entity behavior, abundance claims and absolute safety ratings are not imported automatically.

sublevels.name: Zenith Station
sublevels.environment: A colossal futuristic metal-and-glass station embedded as a Level 0 sub-section, with broad chambers, glass apertures, damaged electronics and space-station-like architecture.
sublevels.gameplay: Treat it as a rare architectural pocket inside Project Level 0. Keep Level 0's resource scarcity and Project Entity rules unless an encounter/resource is separately validated. Return routes lead back into Level 0 continuity.

sublevels.name: Remodeled Mess
sublevels.environment: A remodeled Level 0 pocket with dry red carpet, white walls, working-looking fixtures and an under-construction feel. After entry, ceilings, walls and floors can collapse in a spreading chain reaction before the area later appears reset.
sublevels.gameplay: Use structural collapse, dust and unstable flooring as the main hazards. A door can return to Level 0. Do not import the external remodeling organization as established Project canon.

sublevels.name: The Icy Rooms
sublevels.environment: A Level 0-like interior overwhelmed by ice, frost and severe cold, with frozen carpet, walls and large ice masses obstructing rooms.
sublevels.gameplay: Cold exposure, slippery surfaces and blocked routes are authoritative Project-adaptation hazards. Keep the source's trimmed/rewrite status in provenance rather than treating every old detail as current canon.

sublevels.name: Aquaclaustrophobic Infirmary
sublevels.environment: Waterlogged cream-walled passages with short blue lighting lead into abandoned medical/infirmary spaces. Dirty standing water, confinement, poor visibility and biological contamination make prolonged travel dangerous.
sublevels.gameplay: Use water exposure, infection risk, fatigue and difficult exits as environmental pressure. Any medical supplies remain subject to Project scarcity and loot authority.

sublevels.name: The Reminiscence District
sublevels.environment: A temporal/historical Level 0 sub-section whose architecture changes through older-looking eras as one travels deeper, including early-modern, medieval and ancient-looking interiors.
sublevels.gameplay: Treat historical layers as unstable spatial/temporal regions, not proof of a definitive Backrooms history. Fire, old materials, toxic finishes, isolation and deeper hostile encounters can increase risk. Backtracking can return to Level 0.

sublevels.name: Corrupted Corridor
sublevels.environment: A very long straight white-and-blue corridor inside Level 1. It grows progressively less stable: slopes, repeating sections, abnormal colors, blocked passages and deep dark sectors become more severe with distance.
sublevels.gameplay: Use increasing geometric instability as the progression spine. Project Entity hard locks decide actual encounters. Source settlement/faction claims are not imported. Backtracking or local transitions return to Level 1.

sublevels.name: Concrete Garden
sublevels.environment: Grey concrete corridors and pillars are overtaken by grass, flowers and dense plant growth, creating an anomalous garden within Level 1 architecture.
sublevels.gameplay: Vegetation is not automatically edible or safe. Prolonged exposure can distort memory, identity and the body in the source concept; in Project gameplay those effects require observable buildup and cannot become an instant hidden penalty. Return transitions reconnect to Level 1.

sublevels.name: Malignance
sublevels.environment: A pristine white medical complex whose initially restorative spaces become corrupted by malignant biological overgrowth and dangerous decay-like effects.
sublevels.gameplay: Use the current dangerous/corrupted interpretation, not the early safe-hospital premise as a free healing station. Any healing, transformation or contamination must be earned by explicit state and observable evidence.

sublevels.name: Inverted
sublevels.environment: An inverted reality pocket with black-and-white distortions, upside-down geometry, fluorescent fixtures that appear to radiate darkness and surroundings that can be illuminated without a normal source.
sublevels.gameplay: Make orientation, perception and route reliability the main hazards. The area is difficult to exit; no guaranteed exit is created. Keep Project fairness: effects need spatial/time/evidence basis and cannot arbitrarily disable established capabilities.
